name: EASEP LRRR
about: EASEP LRRR (1969-059, MSC), launched 1969 Jul 16. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
